summary: ADR-0058 accepted 2026-08-18; Acceptance-owned persisted runs, action DAGs, append-only events, command registries, route projections, and receipts form evidence root; requests identify target plan and prepared input only, never route truth or lifecycle authority; action results bind run/event/registry/candidate/contract/Knowledge/Skill-input/validator identities; v2 request data is historical-only; caller-authored graphs, mismatched receipts, and unregistered actions rejected; coordinator is reentrant/replayable; Acceptance alone owns acceptance-passed; no Bootstrap ownership, auto-start, release, or commit authority
